subject: Capacity slab check + purchase lane
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: David Chen <david.chen@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Emily Tran <emily.tran@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: capacity slab check & next steps

Hi David / Emily,

Thanks again for carving out time earlier — good call. Quick recap and two asks so we can get you a firm purchase path: 

Recap from our side:
- Target use case: anonymized clinical note generation + patient triage embeddings for search.
- Typical sequence lengths: 350-700 tokens; average response ~420 tokens.
- Expected QPS pattern: bursty mornings (08:00–11:00 PT) and steady tail afternoons.
- Initial pilot horizon: 3 months, then scale to production.

Cost qualification we discussed:
- Rough target monthly spend band you mentioned: $40k–$120k/month.
- Target unit economics asked: you wanted to validate a target price around $15–$25 per 1M tokens.
- Procurement threshold: you indicated anything above ~$50k/mo will need PO + longer legal review.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm your expected monthly commit band (low / expected / high)? If the band is accurate, we’ll map to commit discounts and compute a committed price per 1M tokens.
2) Please confirm procurement gate — if PO required at $50k+, we’ll route finance & legal earlier.

I attached a preliminary pricing workbook (token math and simple sensitivity) and a short SOW draft to speed procurement.

If those numbers align, I can propose two concrete purchase lanes: a 3-month pilot/consumption plan and a 12-month reserved lane with a committed token bucket + lower $/1M token.

Best,
Sean
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-pricing-1m-token-breakdown.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-sow-draft.pdf (pdf)
From: David Chen <david.chen@lumenhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Tran <emily.tran@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: capacity slab check & next steps

Thanks, Sean — good summary.

Confirming the numbers from our side:
- Low / Expected / High monthly spend: $35k / $85k / $140k. That "expected" of $85k is what we'd aim for if the pilot meets latency and quality checks.
- Procurement gate: correct — anything over $50k/month triggers our central procurement and requires an approved PO. Estimated legal lead time on vendor agreements is ~3 weeks (standard).
- Unit economics target: $20/1M tokens is the threshold we need to hit for the ROI model to work against our current cloud TCO. If you can show committed pricing in that ballpark with predictable latency, we can move fast.

Two asks on our side before we proceed: 
1) Can you provide SOC 2 Type II evidence and the standard latency SLA you target at the committed band?
2) For the pilot, can we do a 30–45 day trial with a capped spend of $30k without jumping into the full procurement cycle?

If you can confirm the PO threshold handling and provide a committed $/1M token example for the $85k band, I’ll prep internal stakeholders.

—David
Director, Applied AI
Lumen Health
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: David Chen <david.chen@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up: capacity slab check & next steps

Forwarding David's confirmation and asks to finance/legal ops. Monica / Marissa — David from Lumen confirmed low/expected/high band of $35k/$85k/$140k and that anything >$50k/mo requires a PO. He also called out $20/1M tokens as their target unit cost.

Goals for internal next steps:
- Monica: can you run the $85k/month band through the committed-discount model and return an illustrative price deck showing:
  * 3-month pilot (capped $30k spend, no PO required) — recommended price per 1M tokens for pilot (on consumption).
  * 12-month reserved lane (commit bucket mapping to $85k/mo) — committed $/1M token, estimated monthly effective cost after applied discounts.
  * Suggested play for hitting $20/1M tokens (commit size needed + optional quantization or batching recommendations).
- Marissa: legal/bizops — confirm PO handling timeline and whether we can offer a 30–45 day capped pilot without requiring a full vendor contract. If not, propose a minimal signature SOW + invoice approach.

Also tagging our infra notes: given their seq lengths (avg ~420 tokens) and QPS pattern, rolling a "steady burst" autoscale policy with prefix caching should shave ~12–18% off token compute compared to naive runs. That will help the token-econ math. I'll attach the sensitivity tab for reference.

Thanks — if you can get a draft price table back by Friday EOD, I’ll share with David and Emily and get procurement moving.

Sean
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Follow-up: capacity slab check & next steps

Quick pricing readout (initial pass) — Sean, ping me if you want to review the sheet together.

Pilot lane (30–45 day, capped $30k):
- Offer: consumption (no commit) at $28 / 1M tokens for the pilot, with a single invoice at pilot close. This stays above their $20 goal but keeps procurement light.

12-month reserved lane (aimed at $85k/mo effective spend):
- Commit scenario: 1-year committed spend equivalent to $85k/mo (12-month total $1,020,000).
- Discounting: propose 18% off list for that commit band; effective price ~ $16.40 / 1M tokens (estimated) — gets them under $20 target.
- Important notes: this assumes normal token distribution (avg 420) and standard quantization profile. If they request per-token perks (lower KV cache retention or higher priority routing) price adjusts.

PO & legal handling:
- Marissa: confirmed our standard PO acceptance process. For $50k+/mo deals we require a PO + 2–3 week legal review; however, we can do the pilot on a minimal SOW + invoice to avoid full vendor onboarding. We can also pre-seed a short "intent to purchase" letter to accelerate the 12-month lane.

Next steps I recommend we take to David:
1) Send two clear purchase lanes (Pilot: $28/1M capped $30k; Reserved 12m: $16.40/1M on $1.02M commit) and call out the PO threshold and expected legal lead time.
2) Attach SOC 2 summary and latency SLA (I’ll ask infra for a 99.5% P99 latency target doc to include).

I can assemble the one-pager and revised pricing workbook by Friday.

—Monica
Director, Pricing & GTM Economics
Redwood Inference
